source: Reconstructed: the 2026-11-03 book with every field that pricingsaas.com recorded as changed between its Nov 2 and Nov 9, 2026 captures set back to its Nov 2 value (Starter 10 seats with no bonus, Essential 20 seats, 40,000 events, and 4,000 AI Actions, Ultimate 2,000,000 events and 100,000 AI Actions, no promotion; pricingsaas.com/companies/pagerduty/diffs/2026W46). Fields not reported as changed are assumed unchanged. The tracker's change log (pricingsaas.com/companies/pagerduty, week of Nov 2) also says 'Starter also gains a new 30-seat cap', but the diff page does not list it, so the pre-launch cap is unknown; this book keeps it at 30.
